purpose: build the project according to the configured language and build mode
config_touchpoints: build.* -> binaries or library checks or Python distributions or Rust crate packages
output: language-specific build output Swift verifies libraries or packages native executable artifacts. TypeScript verifies libraries or compiles native Bun CLI executables with checksums.

purpose: run language tests with summary or per-test output
output: Go JSON or Dart JSON or Python JUnit XML or Rust standard harness pretty output. Rust includes doctests; custom harnesses require summary style. Swift combines serial XCTest results with Swift Testing JSON schema 0 and rejects incomplete reports. TypeScript runs npm test with Node JUnit reports and per-test output.

purpose: format sources for the configured language
output: Go gofmt or Dart format or Python locked Ruff format or Rust cargo fmt --all Swift formats target-owned sources and Package.swift using swift format. TypeScript runs project-local Biome formatting through Node.

purpose: run static checks without fixing sources
output: Go vet or Dart analyze or Python Ruff or Rust Clippy with warnings denied across workspace targets Swift runs strict formatter lint and compiles sources/tests with warnings as errors. TypeScript runs Biome checks without fixes and tsc --noEmit.

purpose: measure coverage and apply the shared threshold policy
output: Go coverage or Dart LCOV or Python JSON or Rust cargo-llvm-cov LCOV. Rust stable coverage excludes doctests and dependency/generated directories. Swift uses LLVM JSON production-source line coverage weighted by line count. TypeScript uses fresh c8 source-mapped LCOV reports from npm test; unimported production files receive zero coverage and shared thresholds remain authoritative.

purpose: run build then publish a GitHub release from the configured release settings
config_touchpoints: build.* and release.* -> GitHub release with optional assets

purpose: bootstrap a repo-local config and initial GitHub defaults
reconcile GitHub repo metadata from local config with explicit safety flags
config_touchpoints: .gh-flarebyte.cue -> GitHub repo state with `--confirm-deletions` and `--accept-visibility-change-consequences` when needed

purpose: compare local config with remote GitHub state
list repositories the user contributes to within an org
run an independent Bun or Python e2e suite
output: Bun JUnit or Python unittest discovery; empty suites fail.

purpose: execute a Bun TypeScript or Python file with forwarded arguments
output: Child output and exit status; no shell interpolation.
